classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the mandatory statutory national-interest determination authorizing the drawdown of specified defense assistance for Colombia; the legally consequential determination occurs in this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: I hereby determine that it is in the national interest of the United States to drawdown defense articles

classifications.rationale: The President presently directs and authorizes the drawdown of up to $7 million in specified defense articles, services, and training; any later delivery is ministerial implementation of this immediate legally consequential act.
classifications.evidence: I hereby direct the drawdown of up to $7 million of such defense articles
